basic_details.job_title: Panjab University Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The A.C. Joshi Library, Panjab University, Chandigarh has 5 Apprentice Trainee seats for a 12-month apprenticeship (session 2026-2027). The stipend is Rs. 9000/- p.m. for B. Lib & Inf. Sc. holders and Rs. 8000/- p.m. for Diploma in Library & Information Science holders. Candidates apply through the NATS (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme) portal, and the last date to apply is 5 November 2026.

qualification.details: Post Qualification Required Apprentice Trainee 1-Year Bachelor in Library & Information Science or 3-Years Diploma in Library & Information Science, with 55% (percentage) | Candidates must have already passed the examination from a recognized University/College/Institute/any State Board of Technical Education in India. Only candidates registered on the NATS portal will be considered for the training. | Preference will be given to candidates who have knowledge in computer and IT, library software and data entry skills. | The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

salary_details.details: The notice marks both amounts with "*(To be revised)". No other financial benefits will be given. The apprenticeship training lasts 12 months, for session 2026-2027. Accommodation or hostel facility will not be provided to selected candidates.

selection_process: The list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the NATS portal and on the Notice Board of the Librarian's Office. It will also be uploaded on the library website under the "Notice board" category (https://library.puchd.ac.in/show-noticeboard.php?nbid=1).

The notice mentions a test/interview. Candidates must bring their original certificates on the date of the test/interview. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the selection process. The date of the test/interview is not specified in the notice.
how_to_apply: Register on the NATS (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme) portal. Only candidates registered on the NATS portal will be considered.
Use the NATS student manual, which the notice gives at https://nats.education.gov.in/assets/manual/student_manual.pdf, to learn how to register and apply.
Apply through the NATS portal for the A.C. Joshi Library, Panjab University, Chandigarh apprenticeship by 5 November 2026.
For queries, contact Dr. Suman Sumi at 0172-2534561 / 9872114404 or [email protected] on any working day (Monday to Friday) between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must have already passed the examination from a recognized University/College/Institute/any State Board of Technical Education in India. Only candidates registered on the NATS portal will be considered for the training. Preference will be given to candidates who have knowledge in computer and IT, library software and data entry skills. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions. As per the Apprentices Act conveyed by B.O.A.T., (N.R.) Kanpur, candidates who passed the course before five years are not eligible for apprenticeship training. The gap between the date of declaration of results and the date of recruitment should not be more than five years. Reservation is as per the Apprentices Act, 1961. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of the 5 seats.

faq.question: Q1. How many Apprentice Trainee seats are offered by the A.C. Joshi Library, Panjab University?
faq.answer: The A.C. Joshi Library, Panjab University, Chandigarh offers 5 Apprentice Trainee seats for session 2026-2027.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PU A.C. Joshi Library apprenticeship?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the PU Apprentice Trainee seats?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 1-Year Bachelor in Library & Information Science or a 3-Years Diploma in Library & Information Science with 55%, already passed from a recognized University/College/Institute/any State Board of Technical Education in India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for the PU A.C. Joshi Library Apprentice Trainee?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 9000/- p.m. for B. Lib & Inf. Sc. holders and Rs. 8000/- p.m. for Diploma in Library & Information Science holders, for 12 months. The notice says both amounts are to be revised and no other financial benefits will be given.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the A.C. Joshi Library apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Register and apply through the NATS (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme) portal by 5 November 2026. Only candidates registered on the NATS portal will be considered.

faq.question: Q6. How will Apprentice Trainees be selected at the A.C. Joshi Library?
faq.answer: The list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the NATS portal, the Librarian's Office notice board and the library website, and candidates must bring original certificates on the date of the test/interview.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply if I passed my library science course more than five years ago?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who passed the course before five years are not eligible; the gap between the declaration of results and the date of recruitment should not be more than five years.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA or hostel accommodation be given to apprentices?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the selection process, and accommodation/hostel facility will not be provided to selected candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Which skills get preference in the PU Apprentice Trainee selection?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates with knowledge in computer and IT, library software and data entry skills.
